'''September 2001 Colorado Springs tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Hobby Town, Colorado Springs, Colorado on 16 September 2001. [[Thomas Harris]] won it. It is known from Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2976">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-17-colorado-springs-a-shot-at-foils-9-16-01d2976/ colorado-springs-a-shot-at-foils-9-16-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 17 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-17-colorado-springs-a-shot-at-foils-9-16-01d2976/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Hobby Town, Colorado Springs, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Thomas Harris]]
